prompts.down: Create a production original dark fantasy pixel-painted RPG character animation sprite sheet of the SAME muscular bald tan-skinned berserker as reference: bare muscular torso, diagonal dark leather straps, one large horned animal-skull shoulder guard, opposite black spiked shoulder armor, dark studded leather battle skirt, wrapped forearms, tall brown boots and black shin guards, enormous wide heavy chipped two-handed iron cleaver sword with two dark metal bands. Subtle blue flame aura. Exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows of equal square cells, 12 separate full-body poses. Strict regular grid, no text, no banner, no numbers, no divider lines, no ground, no checkerboard. TRUE transparent background. Each sprite centered inside its own cell, generous padding 15%, no weapon or aura crossing any cell edge. Character body same size and foot baseline in each cell. Row1 four DISTINCT walk cycle phases with sword held in both hands low: left step, passing, right step, passing. Row2 four DISTINCT attack frames: lift sword overhead windup, forward cleaving swing, heavy orange slash impact with compact sparks, recovery to low guard. Row3 col1 blue aura preparation, col2 blue energy war cry release, col3 stagger hit reaction, col4 crouched recovery. Keep all12 poses isolated. Preserve appearance and coherent armor and sword across all poses. The sword must remain visible and complete with no cut-off blade. ALL 12 poses face FRONT 3/4 looking toward viewer and slightly right, game down direction. Use reference solely for character identity, not its checkerboard.
